kind.description: One report type per report; picks the skeleton (see the prompt doc).

title.description: What this report is about, ≤ 22 CJK chars.

asOf.description: When the evidence was taken, human readable.

reason.description: Required for at_risk / off_track: cause and fix in one line.

overview.description: Experiment reports: "what we are doing", for a reader who is not in the loop. Shown first, before the first chart and the verdict.

question.description: The research question in plain words.

compare.description: What is compared: the method vs the baseline, and what is held equal.

setup.description: Data and settings: datasets (size, chance level), the compared conditions (e.g. cross-subject / cross-session), runs.

complete.description: What counts as complete training (the formal results) and what does not, e.g. "350 epochs = fully trained; 30-epoch runs are under-trained".

why.description: Why it matters, in one or two sentences.

tldr.description: The answer first: ≤ 3 sentences. Shown in the verdict card and on the cover slide.

impact.description: What the result means for the goal, in the reader's terms (users, time, money, the research question): "so what". Shown under the verdict.

risk.description: The biggest risk and its response; shown on the first page, never only at the end.

text.description: The biggest risk or open doubt, in plain words.

plan.description: What is being done about it (road to green), with owner or date when known.

next.description: ≤ 3 one-line next steps, shown as numbered chips under the verdict.

title.description: Short topic label, shown small above the takeaway.

takeaway.description: The section's conclusion as one sentence; becomes the slide headline.
